jars: The call was their smallness, not your measure
Let the wind move. You are the ground it moves across.
Make the bed, or fold the clothes, or call the parent far away
best: Your body still wakes as if the office is waiting. The shock sits heavy and silent. You are carrying the ten minute call alone while your mind pulls at the shape of the last twenty two years.
day1_verdict: This actually names the 6 AM wake-up and the ten minute call, which hits right in the chest.
